Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PlayPets cozy illustrated game transparent tree sprite sheet.
Style: match the reference trees exactly: the same soft painterly illustrated look, warm brown bark with gentle highlights, the same small green root rosette at each base, the same size and proportions as the reference mature trees, key light from the upper left. TRUE transparent alpha background: NO painted background, NO sky, NO snow, NO ground beyond the root rosette, NO cast shadow, NO text.
Landscape 1536x1024 canvas, exactly THREE bare mature WINTER trees in three equal columns, each centered and standing on the same baseline near the bottom with 8% transparent padding, nothing crossing the column boundaries.
In the reference the three winter trees (left three) are the same brown rounded bare tree. Make each one unmistakable at a glance, at 80 px, by its own shape, bark colour and the little things it keeps in winter:
COL1: winter CHERRY tree: a wide, spreading UMBRELLA-shaped crown, wider than tall, branches arching outward and slightly down; smooth glossy dark RED-BROWN to plum bark with clear pale HORIZONTAL bands (lenticels) on the trunk; many short twigs dotted with plump round pinkish-brown flower BUDS.
COL2: winter MAPLE tree: a tall, airy, UPRIGHT oval crown, narrower than the others, with many fine slender twigs whose ends are bright CORAL-RED; smooth light grey-brown bark; a few pairs of dry tan winged maple seeds (samaras) still hanging from the twigs.
COL3: winter OAK tree: a massive short trunk with deeply FURROWED grey-brown bark, thick gnarled ZIG-ZAG branches in a broad rugged crown, and many DRY curled tan-brown oak leaves with rounded lobes still CLINGING all over the crown (oaks keep their dead leaves in winter).
